# AEO Checker

> Free on page Answer Engine Optimization audit and Gemini visibility check.

AEO Checker scores a public URL from 0 to 100 on whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity can crawl, understand, and cite it. After the score, Gemini answers buyer questions so you can see whether the brand is mentioned.

## Pages

- [Free AEO Checker](/aeo-checker): Paste a URL, get a score, visibility table, and fix list.
- [Home](/): How the checker works and FAQ.
- [About](/about): Who publishes the tool.
- [Contact](/contact): Book a free AEO consultation.
- [Privacy](/privacy): What we log.
- [Terms](/terms): Scope and acceptable use.

## Notes

- The on page audit is deterministic and does not call an AI model.
- The visibility pass uses Gemini without Google Search grounding.
- New sites often score 0% on mentions. That is expected.
